en: A monochrome image showing an ornate, baroque-style wooden portal with a chevron-patterned door set in an old plastered stone wall. Above the door is a decorated pediment with carvings and an inscription, and the number '32' is visible on one side of the portal. To the left is a multi-paned window, and in the foreground a person is sweeping the cobblestone street. At the bottom margin of the card, printed text reads 'Narwa, Portal Anno 1653,'.
